theme: Dark, futuristic 'control-room' dashboard with neon accents

hierarchy_rules.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl tracking-tighter font-black uppercase

colors.contrast_rules: No pure white backgrounds. Ensure terminal fonts have 4.5:1 contrast against dark backgrounds. Use 1px inner borders for glassmorphism panels to define edges.

surface_styles.dashboard_cards: Retro-Futurism/Terminal Look: Deep black/indigo bg, 1px solid border-cyan-400/20, subtle drop-shadow-[0_0_8px_rgba(0,240,255,0.1)].
surface_styles.chatbot_panel: Glassmorphism with heavy backdrop-blur-xl, saturate-150, 1px inner border of white/10.
surface_styles.critical_metrics: The 'Tracing Beam' effect around the WAI gauge to indicate live processing.

visual_enhancers.textures: Scanlines (CSS repeating-linear-gradient) over the cooling visualization to enhance the control-room feel. Grain/noise overlay on the dark background.
visual_enhancers.decorations: ASCII art loader for the chatbot. Pulsing neon glows on active sliders.

component_name_guidelines.AI_Chatbot: Use Shadcn components heavily customized (border-cyan/30, bg-black/80) to look like a terminal.
component_name_guidelines.Scenario_Simulator: HTML/Tailwind raw inputs with glowing thumbs. Custom styled `<input type='range'>` or Shadcn Sliders styled with neon cyan tracks.
component_name_guidelines.WAI_Gauge: Recharts radial bar chart OR custom SVG with stroke-dashoffset animation. JetBrains Mono for the 0-100 number.
component_name_guidelines.Cooling_Visualization: Framer Motion animated SVG pipes. Colors transition cyan to orange based on state.
component_name_guidelines.Workload_Board: Bento Grid cards. Status dots (green/red) next to workload names.
component_name_guidelines.SDG_Badges: Monochrome or neon-tinted icons representing goals 6, 9, 11, 12, 13.

grids_and_layouts.strategy: High Density Grid (For Dashboards / Analytics) combined with Mode A (Asymmetry) for the Hero.
grids_and_layouts.spacing: Generous Spacing (p-6 to p-8 inside cards). Gap strategy: gap-6 for dashboard items.

layout_structure.Hero: col-span-full, dark background image with gradient overlay, bold Unbounded typography.
layout_structure.Simulator_and_WAI: Bento split: Sliders col-span-1 md:col-span-3, WAI Gauge col-span-1 md:col-span-1 (Hero dominant square).
layout_structure.Cooling_Vis: col-span-full md:col-span-4 row-span-2. Needs height to show schematic.
layout_structure.Workloads_and_Chatbot: Chatbot is fixed sidebar or col-span-1 md:col-span-2 tall card.

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: -translate-y-1, border color darkens to solid cyan, text glows.
motion_and_interactions.transitions: transition-transform 0.2s ease, opacity 0.2s ease. NO transition-all.
motion_and_interactions.data_feed: Subtle pulsing opacity on live data numbers to simulate real-time updates.
motion_and_interactions.cooling_animation: SVG stroke dash animations to show water/coolant flowing through pipes.

accessibility.contrast: APCA contrast verified for cyan on black.
accessibility.motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion for the cooling flow SVGs.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements (sliders, buttons, chatbot input) MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='temp-slider').

hero_background.description: Futuristic circuit board with glowing green/cyan light, perfect for the 'Think Before It Drinks' hero.

water_accent.description: Abstract water splashes on a dark background. Blend mode: overlay/screen.

control_room_reference.description: Dark control room filled with electronic equipment.

media_and_assets.icons: lucide-react for UI components. @phosphor-icons/react for data/tech specific icons.

3d_libraries.recommendation: Framer Motion for simple SVG 2.5D Cooling Visualization (keeps performance high while looking cinematic). Recharts for the WAI gauge.
3d_libraries.install_commands: yarn add framer-motion recharts lucide-react @phosphor-icons/react sonner

instructions_to_main_agent: Install Unbounded, Chivo, and JetBrains Mono from Google Fonts.
Initialize Tailwind config with Void Black (#05050A) background, and Cyan (#00F0FF) / Orange (#FF5C00) accents.
Do NOT use pure white backgrounds or generic SaaS styles. Follow the 'ELECTRIC & NEON' archetype.
Build the dashboard using CSS Grid (High Density). The chatbot should feel like a cinematic terminal.
Build the Cooling System Visualization using an SVG diagram of pipes and heat exchangers. Animate the 'flow' using Framer Motion stroke-dashoffset.
Map the AI decision logic: When WAI is low, UI switches accents to Orange/Red and changes text output.
Ensure 'Export Report' generates a blob or opens a formatted print view.
Implement the 'Tracing Beam' effect on the WAI container to emphasize it is the core AI calculation.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: DO NOT output generic 'AI slop'. Make the UI feel highly custom, edgy, and cinematic.
Dark colors must not be used as flat gradients. Use solid dark backgrounds with neon 1px borders or subtle drop-shadow glows.
DO NOT center align the app container. Respect optical alignment and left-align data logs.
Every slider interaction must instantly update the WAI gauge and Cooling visual (immediate feedback pattern).
DO NOT use emojis for icons. Use Phosphor Icons or Lucide.
Include `data-testid` on all interactive UI components, sliders, and form actions.
Never use fully transparent backgrounds on surfaces that content scrolls beneath.
GENERAL_UI_UX_DESIGN_GUIDELINES: Prioritize cognitive load reduction. Group related sliders (Environment vs Data Center). Ensure real-time state changes are visually obvious through color (cyan = healthy, orange = warning). High contrast is mandatory. Avoid fully transparent backgrounds on interactive elements.
